decisions.reason: Builds directly on the firm's core dosimetry and calibration knowledge, giving strong absorptive capacity to improve and retain this flagship electrometer.
Although the firm has software integration capabilities, oncology risk management is farther from its measurement-based QA core, so absorptive capacity is lower and drop risk is moderate.
The CT phantom fits the firm's existing medical imaging QA expertise, allowing it to interpret early results and refine the product.
Mammography phantoms build on related imaging QA knowledge but may overlap with the full-field phantom, creating some rationalization risk.
The full-field mammography phantom also leverages imaging QA know-how, but its overlap with the other mammography phantom introduces moderate drop risk.
As a flagship medical imaging QA line with multiple models, it closely aligns with the firm's measurement and QA direction and leverages existing R&D capabilities.
